status: Extracted thresholds; source must be applied with every exception, evidence condition and precedence rule

general.mixtureOrder: HPR 2.2(2)-(3): follow first applicable provision in each subpart, except 8.1, 8.4, 8.7, 8.8

acute.ingredientCutoffSource: HPR 8.1.2(2): w/w for solids/liquids/dusts/mists/vapours; v/v for gases

knownATEInclude.other: HPR 8.1.5 comparable inhalation range; expert review if needed

acute.rangeCrossingRule: HPR 8.1.7(2): use lowest experimentally obtained value if range does not fit entirely within one row band

skin.evidenceBelowOnePercent: 8.2.11(1)(b) requires evidence the ingredient is corrosive/irritant at its present concentration

additive.subtypeRule: 8.2.11(2)(a.1)-(a.3) permits matching subcategory 1A/1B/1C only if no other corrosive subcategories or generic 1 are present; mixed corrosives => general Category 1 under (a.4)

skin.specialMixtures: HPR 8.2.11(3) separate table: acid pH≤2, base pH≥11.5, other nonadditive corrosive≥1% => 1, irritant≥3% => 2; requires qualifying chemistry

eye.evidenceBelowOnePercent: 8.3.11(1)(b) requires evidence damage or irritation at present concentration

additive.subtypeRule: 8.3.11(2)(c.1)-(c.3) permits 2A/2B only if the other irritant categories are absent; mixed subtypes => Category 2

eye.specialMixtures: HPR 8.3.11(3): special ingredient table, damage 1% or irritation 3% if qualifying chemistry

unimplementedRuleGroups: skin and eye special ingredient exceptions
